text:
Predicates:
OnTV(x, y, z) ::: x is on TV at time y on day z.
Rose(x) ::: x is a rose.
GivenOut(x) ::: x is given out.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
Portrays(x, y) ::: x portrays y.
RealPeople(y) ::: y is the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Show(x) ::: x is a TV show.
Premises:
∃x ∃y (OnTV(x, 8pm, monday) ∧ Rose(x) ∧ GivenOut(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (OnTV(x, 8pm, monday) ∧ Rose(x) ∧ GivenOut(x)) → Bachelor(x) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → Portrays(x, realPeople)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portrays(x, realPeople) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
OnTV(breakingBad, 8pm, monday) ∧ Rose(x) ∧ GivenOut(x) ::: Breaking Bad is a TV show in which roses are given out on Monday at 8 pm.
